scope: Five source reviews: one complete physical-board five-piece promotion lesson, three complete-source larger analyses, and one middlegame tactic outside endgame scope. Original v3 unchanged.

WZbRoPi8_A0.notes: All 85 saved physical-board states and narration reviewed. Complete five-piece setup: White Kh5/Ba8/b7 versus Black Kh1/Qf4. Four promotion choices are checked at every encoded step: b8=B+/Kg1/Bxf4/Kf1 preserves a White win; b8=Q+/Kg1/Qxf4 is actual stalemate; independently added rook promotion draws and knight promotion loses. The promoted bishop, not Ba8, captures Qf4. After Bxf4 Black has f1 and f2; no two-bishop mate sequence is fabricated. Native image 17 supplies a clear unoccluded root; bases identify squares. Source timings: queen promotion around 20s, bishop promotion around 65s, Kf1 around 81s.

7Yu93iFg2iE.notes: All 53 saved states and narration reviewed. Queen/bishop/pawn stalemate composition with Bb1+, Kxb1, Qf1+, Qd1/Qxd1 and Ka2. Complete settled diagrams are present. After the queen sacrifice there are still eight pieces: White Ka2/Bf7/a3/b2 against Black Ka4/Qd1/a5/b5. No spare pawn is discarded to fit a seven-piece query.
7Yu93iFg2iE.analysis_required: Reconstruct the full larger setup from settled diagrams and verify the Qd1 sacrifice, the direct Ka2/Qa1 stalemate error, Qc2 pin, Be6 zugzwang versus Bd5/b4, and Qc4/b3+/Qxb3/Bxb3 mate with larger-position analysis. Preserve a3/b2/a5/b5 and distinguish illustrated queen choices from all legal defenses. Captions and full digital boards are available; this is an analysis task, not a source gap.

u9TqVKo4tgg.notes: All 51 saved states and narration reviewed. Complete ten-piece root: White Kb8/Bg4/c6/g6 against Black Ka6/Rg1/Ba4/a5/b6/b4. The c7/Rc1/Be2+ interference has both ...Bb5 and ...b5 defenses and a later Bc4 triple sacrifice. Source evidence is present.
u9TqVKo4tgg.analysis_required: Verify the full ten-piece c7/Rc1/Be2+ sequence, the losing immediate c8=Q/Rxc8+/Kxc8/Bb3 blockade, and both check blocks. After ...b5/g7/Bb3/Bc4 retain a5/b5/b4, then analyze each pawn/bishop/rook capture with legal move order and the ensuing promotion/checkmate. Most decisive branches retain more than seven pieces; do not certify them using a stripped board or only the final mate.

OlT6Eg3rIyY.notes: All 110 saved states and narration reviewed. Despite the opening-themed title this is a complete game extending into a real rook-versus-knight ending, rook trade, pawn race and queen mate. It must not be dismissed as an opening-only clip. Source is complete; rapid play may skip intermediate moves at 1fps.
OlT6Eg3rIyY.analysis_required: Reconstruct and analyze the substantial rook-versus-knight phase and the rook trade leading to the pawn race. Preserve the white queenside pawns and Black a6/b5/c6/h6; e.g. the settled diagram after the rook exchange still has nine pieces (White Ke2/a3/b3/b4 versus Black Kh4/a6/b5/c6/h6). Establish legal chronology around the fast captures before selecting any later tablebase-supported race. A terminal queen-mate snippet alone would not verify the interesting earlier decisions. Full saved boards and captions exist.

yCx-mCYmY5k.notes: All 42 saved states and narration reviewed. This is a middlegame attack from Witty Alien versus Magnus: Re1?/Rb1+/Kd2/Qd5+ and the Bc4 resource. Illustrated lines retain many pawns, queens and rooks; the clip returns to the resignation after Qd5+. Narration mentions a simple endgame after hypothetical trades, but does not present a sparse endgame study or a worked conversion. Retained as a searchable channel tactic, not promoted to an Endgame Stories endgame lesson.
